data.narrative:
Allen Control Systems is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Mike Wior, Steve Simoni, and Luke Allen that has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology uses the $200M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yielding an implied valuation of $380M. Peer-median analysis references 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), producing a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $323M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $690M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around capital efficiency and market positioning relative to the peer set. The peer-median method anchors at the higher end of the range, suggesting Allen Control's fundraising trajectory and sector tailwinds may support valuations toward the $1.0B midpoint of comparable Series B rounds. Key uncertainties include relative traction metrics and defensibility versus the highest-valued peers in this cohort.
